Rick and Marty Lagina make an exciting discovery after forging a truce with Dan Blankenship's longtime rival, Fred Nola.
After years of searching and speculation, the Lagina's and their team unearth evidence of what Marty believes proves the exact location of the ultimate target--The Money Pit.

Danger strikes just as the geo-tech drilling team hits a possible void in the Money Pit and the discovery of a long-lost artifact leads to an emotional reunion for one of the surviving members of the legendary Restall family.
Is Britain facing an alien invasion? Does it know more than it’s saying? And is it really dedicated to protecting its citizens? Or is it only protecting itself.
UFO sightings are a worldwide phenomenon.
There are structures as old as time that continue to baffle historians and engineers the world over. Did we build these ancient megaliths ourselves or did aliens guide our hand?
If aliens have visited Earth, why are they here and what are they truly after.
The list of global threats to the human race is long. But could Earth’s armed forces be facing a new enemy that is literally out of this world.
For decades, governments around the world have investigated UFO sightings, often times under an umbrella of secrecy. How are these top-secret studies conducted.
An extraterrestrial threat. A top secret organization. Has the US made contact with aliens? Experts believe they have. And an ultra top secret organization is calling all the shots.
Since the early 1960s, we've experimented with how to travel off planet Earth.
Sandra Waldron finds the supernatural realm fascinating. When she learns that her house is haunted, Sandra tries to perform Wiccan ceremonies and unwittingly opens a paranormal portal.

An unknown entity appears to find pleasure in terrifying 17-year-old Macy Sherman, her younger sister Kelsey and their mom Carrie. The family reaches out for help, praying that they can get rid of the spirit intent on staying in their home forever.

Soon after moving into an older home in a quaint suburb of Cincinnati, OH, Taylor Jones catches her mother practicing black magic in her daughter Isabelle's bedroom. Her fears become reality when Taylor notices Isabelle playing with an invisible friend.
Since childhood, Rebecca has been able to see and hear spirits but has blocked out their attempts to communicate. But after her marriage with Daniel, a ghost emerges who refuses to be ignored.

After moving in their dream home, Edwin Gonzalez and Lillian Otero begin to experience strange occurrences; mysterious footsteps and unexplained noises. Lillian is physically attacked while sleeping and the couple tries to escape, but is it too late?

Patricia is terrorized by a ghost who escapes from the pages of an antique book. Susie feels she has made the biggest mistake of her life but finds forgiveness and unconditional love from the spirit of her grandmother.
